summary: TransAlta Corp (NYSE:TAC) filed a 6-K announcing its acquisition of Mountain Peak Power LLC and Canyon Peak Power LLC, two fully-contracted 318 MW gas peaking facilities in Colorado, from Blackstone. Total transaction value is US$1.0B, comprising assumption of US$750M project-level debt and US$250M equity funded via a concurrent $350M bought deal common share offering (with 15% over-allotment). Assets have 25+ year tolling agreements with investment-grade customers, expected to add ~US$80M annual Adjusted EBITDA. The deal is immediately accretive to Free Cash Flow per Share. Watch regulatory clearance and closing timing; risk-arb focuses on equity offering execution and debt assumption terms.
